lead: A goal's seed handoff opens a session with "nothing of it has landed" over work already on disk.
body: `tools/loop.py:3802` writes `docs/agent/goals/<n>-<slug>.handoff.md` over the live one at the switch, and that seed was written before the goal ran — goal `bigint`'s named a first item, `num-bigint` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/Cargo.toml`, that the previous goal's sessions had committed a dozen commits back. Read `git log --oneline -12` and grep the item's own anchor before taking it: a slug in a subject line is the one thing a seed handoff cannot know.
